facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio para o que foi feito: The meeting was moved. Use by + pessoa só se for importante: It was written by Mia.

facts.label: Foi + particípio
facts.sub: Use was com sujeito singular: The meeting was moved. Use a forma de particípio do verbo. Verbos regulares terminam em -ed; irregulares mudam: written, sent, held.

facts.label: Foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use were com sujeito plural: The cables were replaced. The invitations were sent. Lembre: the passive muda o foco para a coisa, não para quem fez.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “mudaram a reunião” ou “a reunião foi mudada”, com muita liberdade.
compare.tip: Diga: “The meeting was moved. It was cancelled by mistake.”
compare.us: Em inglês, o passivo é muito comum no trabalho: The meeting was moved. Use was/were + particípio. Use by só se quiser dizer quem fez.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say The meeting was moved.
We say The cables was replaced.
By + person shows who did the action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We say The meeting was moved. → Verdadeiro (Passive with was.)
We say The cables was replaced. → Falso (Cables is plural: were replaced.)
By + person shows who did the action. → Verdadeiro (It was written by Mia.)

pages.title: A meeting room in Seattle · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy morning in Seattle. Theo walks into the office with his coffee. Something is different on the board. Earl already knows the news. Plans change fast at work. Theo wants to know what happened.

“Theo, did you see the email? The meeting was moved to Thursday.” says Earl. “No, I did not. Why was it moved? I thought it was set for Tuesday.” says Theo. “The room was booked by another team, so our meeting was postponed.” says Earl.
